camera: Flat front-facing portrait UI; a purchase confirmation modal over a dimmed shop screen.

hudLayout.topThird: Header: chapter book '2' 'CHAPTER'; counters gold coin 10K, green star 2.02K, magenta meeple 13; six-segment progress bar '0/6'. Wood row: quest scroll left, 'UPGRADE CARDS' '0/1' centre, quest scroll right. Khaki 'Shop' title bar with a red 'X' close button at right. Under it a wide grey banner panel with a wooden chest icon, 'Get FREE Loot!' and a timer '01:59:54'. All dimmed.
hudLayout.middleThird: The modal: a dark charcoal panel from ~29% to ~66% height, ~88% of screen width. Top: a full-width amber-gold title bar '150 CARDS'. Below it a small stacked card-pack icon (purple card behind a lime-framed card showing a grinning boy). Then a light grey text panel: 'A pack of 150 random cards for your heroes, henchmen and gear. Duplicates fill a card's progress, and full cards can be upgraded with XP.' Then price '750 Gold' in gold bold text. Then two buttons side by side: lime-olive 'Buy' left, crimson 'Cancel' right.
hudLayout.bottomThird: Dimmed shop grid behind: coloured offer tiles partly hidden at the modal's sides (purple, green, blue), then two rows of three amber gold-pack tiles with dark sack icons: '200 Gold', '500 Gold', '1,000 Gold', '2,000 Gold', '5,000 Gold', '10,000 Gold', each 'Not available yet'. Bottom wood bar: cards icon, 'username', chest icon, cog; 'fps: 60.02'.

keyElements: header with chapter book, counters 10K / 2.02K / 13, progress bar
Shop title bar with red X
Get FREE Loot! banner with timer
card pack icon and description text panel
uiStyle: Chunky soft-slab 9-slice pieces: amber title bar, light grey text panel with a darker lip, lime-olive and crimson raised buttons with darker front faces and hard drop shadows; bold white sans-serif labels.
colorPalette: Dark charcoal modal centre with saturated amber, lime and crimson accents; dim warm amber shop tiles and umber wood around.
composition: Stacked vertical modal: title, icon, description, price, two-button row; the two buttons anchor the bottom of the modal as the CTA.
